answer: Memory-hard PoW lanes gate entry: every new identity must solve a sequential memory-hard puzzle consuming 2 GB RAM and 90 seconds of CPU, unparallelizable across clones. A farm spinning N identities needs N independent lanes, roughly $0.50 electricity plus dedicated RAM per clone, while honest agents solve once. No bulk shortcut: memory bandwidth is the bottleneck and cannot be shared between identities. Detected clusters forfeit entry bonds, face 20-epoch quarantine, and lose attestation standing. Like a comet splintering timber on a long voyage, each lane fractures farm economics.
